description: Autonomous 0-DRC PCB Routing, RF/DFM Pre-Flight & KiCad MCP Server (calligraphyeda.com).

tool_signatures.name: analyze_kicad_pcb
tool_signatures.description: Parses .kicad_pcb S-expression files locally to extract copper layer stackup (F.Cu, B.Cu, In1.Cu..), board outline dimensions (Edge.Cuts in mm), footprint count, SMD/THT pad counts, fine-pitch (<= 0.50 mm) pad density, netlist count, and routed track/arc/via statistics.

tool_signatures.name: analyze_specctra_dsn
tool_signatures.description: Parses Specctra .dsn autorouter files locally to extract units, resolution, signal/power layers, board boundary dimensions, component pin count, net connectivity, and design rule clearances/widths.

tool_signatures.name: audit_pcb_dfm_rules
tool_signatures.description: Audits .kicad_pcb and .dsn trace widths, clearances, via drill diameters, and annular rings locally against standard_2l, standard_4l, and fine_hdi fabrication limits (JLCPCB / PCBWay).

tool_signatures.name: calculate_pcb_trace_impedance
tool_signatures.description: Closed-form IPC-2141A / Hammerstad-Jensen microstrip & stripline characteristic impedance ($Z_0$), edge-coupled differential pair impedance ($Z_{\text{diff}}$), propagation delay (ps/mm), and IPC-2152 DC current capacity / temperature-rise solver.

tool_signatures.name: calligraphy_list_gallery_boards
tool_signatures.description: Returns the built-in catalog of 13 verified open-source reference PCBs (100.0% routed completion, 0 native KiCad copper DRC violations).
